label: PF Backlog 654
title: Execution finalization: HIL-approved accepted/deferred, AC verification, persisted final report, test taxonomy

decisions.note: HIL approves the 2 accepted design findings (cost_source/test-kind taxonomy; 2.5 does not certify ACs).

brief.problem: Accepted/deferred dispositions were not HIL-approved, ACs were not verified at Gate 2, and final results (tests/time/tokens/cost) were only terminal output.
brief.what_adds: HIL-approved disposition policy, AC verification gate, persisted final_report on the item, and test-result taxonomy.
brief.why_now: The backlog item must be the durable record of what shipped, what was accepted/deferred, and the evidence.
brief.success: An item cannot complete or merge without <=2 HIL-approved accepted per mode, all ACs PASS, and a persisted final report.

objective: Make the execution trail's final update durable and reviewable: cap ACCEPTED, require HIL approval for every ACCEPTED/DEFERRED, verify every AC before Gate 2/merge, classify/list test results by kind, and persist the final report (ACs, tests, time, tokens, cost, dispositions) on the backlog item.
acceptance_criteria: Disposition policy: ACCEPTED is capped at 2 per review mode (design, diff); every ACCEPTED and DEFERRED requires a HIL DISPOSITION_APPROVAL (hil_confirmed, mode, finding sigs); DEFERRED cites an existing backlog id. Enforced at Gate 1, Gate 2 and completion.

AC verification: item.ac_verification records each AC with PASS/FAIL/PENDING + evidence + verifier; Gate 2 refuses if any AC is missing/FAIL/PENDING; completion re-checks. 2.5 may flag AC gaps but does not certify.

Final report: scripts/dev/finalize_item.py persists item.final_report with ACs, test results by kind (unit/api/db/logic/go/other, command/result/counts/duration), total time, input/output/cached tokens, cost + cost_source, accepted/deferred with ids, and gate decisions; completion/merge is blocked without it.

Execution trail show renders AC verification, test results by kind, accepted/deferred dispositions, totals and a final table; tests cover disposition cap/approval, final-report build/persist, test classification, and completion guards.
Docs/state: config/review-dispositions.json + store-registry entry; REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE documents the approval, AC and final-report contract; language-rule/store/wired checks pass.
out_of_scope: No automatic model review caching changes
approach: Execution flow view hardening: pre-merge blocked set, review-sha integrity, no-review cache, review markers

assumptions: Disposition approvals are HIL-owned decisions on the item
AC verification is Gate 2; 2.5 only flags gaps
final_report is persisted by the backlog owner via backlog.update
divergences: BI-PF-1483 flow view did not enforce accepted/deferred approval or AC verification; this item adds it.

ACs cover cap/approval, AC verification, final report, show/test taxonomy, docs.
Edits to allowlisted core/execution_trail.py; new scripts/dev tooling.
Extends execution trail/backlog; no new store except config/review-dispositions.json.

AC verification at Gate 2; accepted/deferred HIL approval; completion guard.
CLI/completion gates; revert restores prior behavior; no migration.

verification: Objective achieved: Execution flow view hardening: pre-merge blocked set, review-sha integrity, no-review cache, review markers
risks: Existing completed items without ac_verification/final_report will need backfill or grandfathering; the completion guard is forward-looking for items completing in the diff.
rollback: Revert the commit; the prior trail show/completion behavior returns. No data migration.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/engineering_flow.py + core/context_review.py/cross_review.py: (1) pre-merge blocked-set check (open blockers, unresolved findings, sha mismatch) gating merge/push; (2) record review sha and verify worktree sha integrity before execution write-back; (3) cache no-review decisions per (item, sha, scope) to skip redundant provider calls; (4) add review markers on the execution trail for audit. Wire into /execution API response; config via config/engineering-flow.json.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES core/engineering_flow.py execution flow present (it is)
RELATED BI-PF-0421 (optimistic delivery lane) required_state=merged to avoid double verify
RELATED BI-PF-1240 stuck recovery for marker cleanup on orphan reaps
conflict_findings: BI-PF-0421 touches merge/re-verify path in same module: serialize or rebase on top
BI-PF-0413 touches worker write-back; coordinate marker emission point
duplication_findings: BI-PF-0421 overlaps on rebase->fast re-verify->merge lane: reuse its verify hook, do not duplicate
BI-PF-0413 worker write-back path is the consumer; do not re-implement claim/exec
analysis.rationale: Pure hardening of existing flow modules: EXTEND/MODIFY rather than new components; reuse execution trail for markers, existing review modules for sha integrity and cache. Conflicts limited to BI-PF-0421 merge lane, resolvable by ordering.
assumptions: Review results are already persisted per sha in context/cross review modules
engineering-flow.json is the single config owner for flow gates
Provider call is the default review path; cache only short-circuits identical (item,sha,scope)
risks: sha mismatch false positives block valid merges if rebase occurred silently
no-review cache keying too broadly could skip a needed review after scope change
merge of blocked-set logic with optimistic lane ordering conflicts
evidence: Candidate components core/engineering_flow.py, context_review.py, cross_review.py, execution_trail.py exist
missing_info: Which merge paths are authoritative (optimistic lane vs serialized) for blocked-set enforcement
Cache TTL/invalidation policy for no-review entries
Whether sha-integrity failure should block, warn, or auto-rebase

sig:c7ea2a9f72722a50.note: core/execution_trail.py is allowlisted control-plane evidence tooling (ADR-0010); this is an edit to the existing show, not a new shipped policy engine. language_rule_check passes.

sig:dfdd4f9535f4957c.note: Grandfathering: the completion guard applies to items that complete in the committed diff; existing completed items without ac_verification/final_report are not retroactively failed. The finalize report is required for new completions.

sig:0f597da9bb8ada28.note: disposition_policy.py is the single policy owner; gate1_check, gate_decisions and execution_trail_check call it. No duplicate cap/approval logic.

sig:6acd170b5d1754b4.note: Signatures use review_sig.digest over full normalized finding text (no timestamps/order), already shared by architect_review; approvals are content-bound.

sig:51d622dbe08f36c9.note: Caps are independent per mode: design <=2 and diff <=2 (max 4 accepted per item across both). Tests cover per-mode; combined is the sum.

sig:b72a93b84ef73916.note: finalize_item writes one backlog.update (atomic write-then-rename in core.backlog); no partial final_report. Re-running is idempotent.

sig:a4f86777c8ddec22.note: DEFERRED ids are checked against the backlog via dp.problems(backlog_get) at Gate 1, Gate 2 and completion; missing/closed ids fail.

sig:499f14987ae14026.note: cost_source values are enumerated in core.execution_trail; test-kind 'other' is intentional; per-kind sums are derived from the same rows. Accepted.

sig:192f782a1c631db2.note: Gate refusals print explicit reasons to stdout/stderr; metrics are out of scope. Accepted.

sig:e97df35ebdab7e9a.note: Gate refusals print explicit reasons to stdout/stderr; no silent failure. Metrics are out of scope; accepted behavior is explicit.

sig:1190a707af99a2b4.note: Extra fields are ignored by read paths; rollback leaves final_report/ac_verification inert. No migration.
